intro: Philemon is Paul's shortest letter: a personal note asking a friend to forgive.
Onesimus had run away from his master, Philemon, and become a Christian through Paul. Paul sends him back, asking Philemon to receive him not as a servant, but as a brother.
Listen for how the good news changes relationships.

card.parts: Ch. 1: a plea for a runaway
